Coram : D.Y. CHANDRACHUD*, A.S. BOPANNA
Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 – ss. 2(b), 7 and 11(6) – Arbitration agreement – Attributes – Contract Agreement entered between appellant (a subsidiary of CIL) and respondent on 30 January 2012 – Dispute between the parties – by respondent before the High Court for appointment of arbitrator – Challenged, on ground that there was no arbitration agreement between the parties within meaning of ss.2(b) and 7 – Held: It was wrong on the part of the High Court to construe Clause 15 of the Contract Agreement
Decision Date : 25-07-2022 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 4914/2022 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
